curricula.title: Basic Math
curricula.description: Level 0: easiest addition (sums ≤5, no zeros), 4-option MC grid only. L1: add within 10 + harder under-8 adds + easy subtract. L2: zero-identity + doubles/near-doubles + more subtract. L3: light multiply + ×0/×1 identity. Idle answer hints until first correct of the day.

curricula.title: First Access
curricula.description: Pre-math UI readiness: what-comes-next number/letter sequences, pad rush-blockers. L0 forward+light reverse+letters A–I; L1 reverse-focus; L2 patterns+answer-centered pad; L3 randomized pad readiness.
